extracted.intended_audience: comedy fans, Las Vegas visitors, and potential ticket buyers
extracted.subtask_description: A press-style announcement describing the Laugh Factory's launch at Horseshoe Las Vegas, including venue details, lineup, schedule, ticketing, and promotional positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue capacity and rebranding
rubrics_metrics.description: Rebrand the 250-seat Imagine Showroom as the new Laugh Factory Las Vegas Theater.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page specifies a 250-seat venue; the capacity and formal rebranding of an existing showroom are presented as core facts about the new operation and affect programming scale and audience experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show format — classic three-person lineup
rubrics_metrics.description: Two shows nightly in a classic comedy club three-person lineup of headliner, feature act and host.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the program model for the soft opening (two shows nightly with headliner, feature, and host). This is presented as the desired format for performances and implies expectations for act ordering and set lengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating schedule and performance times
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh Factory at the Horseshoe plans to operate Monday–Sunday with two shows nightly at 8:30 and 10:30 p.m., with additional special event headliner residencies Thursday–Sunday at 6:30 p.m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies regular nightly showtimes and additional early-evening residency performance windows; affects booking, audience planning, and event programming cadence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age restriction (21+)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear access restriction for attendees; relevant for marketing, ticketing, and entry policy enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing logistics and pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Tickets for its initial soft opening are on sale Tuesday, December 16 at 10 a.m. and start at $37.95 plus tax and fees. Tickets are available for purchase at Ticketmaster.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies sale date/time, starting price, and point-of-sale; useful as a procedural requirement for buyers and for aligning promotional schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lineup curation — blend of legends and viral stars
rubrics_metrics.description: Lineup to celebrate comedy’s evolution featuring comedians from classic standup legends to today’s viral stars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page emphasizes programming that mixes established comedic 'legends' (examples listed) with modern viral/digital-age comedians — a curation criterion guiding talent selection and brand positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency headliner strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The venue will host mini-residencies and special event headliner residencies (example: Concrete mini-residency Feb. 12–15, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a booking strategy of short-run residencies for headline acts in addition to nightly shows; affects marketing, ticketing windows, and talent relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Soft opening and grand opening timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Soft opening weekend Jan 29–Feb 1 with Bret Ernst (two shows nightly) followed by a Grand Opening celebration on President’s Day weekend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the staged-opening approach (soft open then grand opening) and names the soft-opening headliner; useful as a planning and publicity criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand legacy and talent-development positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh Factory's nearly 50-year history launching major stand-up comedians and continuing to deliver talent from biggest stars to up-and-coming comedians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The venue's historical reputation and track record (names cited) are used as credentials to justify programming and to attract audiences and talent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership with resort operator and integrated resort positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnership with Caesars Entertainment’s Horseshoe Las Vegas; rebranding of an on-property showroom and integration into resort entertainment offerings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the venue within a larger resort ecosystem (amenities, cross-promotion with other shows, dining, casino), implying expectations for guest experience and commercial collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional claims and third-party endorsements
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of promotional endorsements (e.g., 'hailed as “the #1 comedy club in the country” by USA Today') in messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The announcement relies on third-party accolades and name recognition as part of its marketing narrative; this is a messaging/evaluation criterion for credibility in publicity.
